# Settings form section

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

An edit/update controller under the settings route group renders resources/js/pages/settings/<Section>/Page.vue in the settings layout.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make settings-section --flavor=form <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui SettingsFrame, @kit/ui FormCard, @kit/ui Field.
- `SettingsFrame` from `@kit/ui` for the settings shell: The settings layout and nav (props: title).
- `FormCard` from `@kit/ui` for the form: The section form (props: title, @submit).
- `Field` from `@kit/ui` for the field: Label, input and error (props: label, error).
- `Input` from `@kit/ui` for the input: A text setting (props: v-model).
- `FormActions` from `@kit/ui` for the submit: Save button (props: processing).
Checks: 20, 21, toast, actions. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Does the settings group need its own nav section, or join an existing settings class?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=settings.form` to see its siblings.
